title: Dynamic Snake Upsampling Operater and Boundary-Skeleton Weighted Loss for Tubular Structure Segmentation
mechanism: Upsampling operator that adapts its stride and picks sub-pixel samples along a serpentine path; distance-field loss weighting skeleton to boundary.
adaptation: Replace bilinear upsampling in the last two U-Net++ decoder stages; skip the boundary weighting (a 1.75 px label is all boundary).
min_experiment: Arm: snake upsampling, 5 seeds; baseline house. Metrics crack relF1@2, components found. Kill: gains < 0.01.
evidence: Plug-in gains in pixel accuracy and topology across datasets and backbones (abstract; numbers not read).
